_comment: Season packs. Bought with gems (player.wallet.gems, 💎) via `.pack buy <id>`, repeatable. A pack grants: its armor set (items[]), an optional weapon, a title, and one signature combat effect that is live only while the pack is the player's active pack (player.activePack). Owned packs live in player.ownedPacks[]; `.pack equip <id>` swaps activePack + displayed title. Signature effects are wired in lib/premium-abilities.js and fire from absorbDamage (defender-side: dodge/phase/dread) or the combat hit-sites (attacker-side: flame_thorns/riposte/lifesteal/rage) or the death-save path (undying_flourish). Gem prices span 50 to 150.
name: Space Sifter
title: 🌀 The Space Sifter
flavor: The robe of one who walks between places. Blows meant for you land where you no longer are.
signatureDesc: Phase: 35% chance to slip a hit entirely and take no damage from it.

_comment: Red Monster: the angrier and closer to death, the harder you hit.
name: Red Monster
title: 👹 The Red Monster
flavor: The hide of a beast that only grows fiercer as the wounds pile on. Pain is just fuel.
signatureDesc: Bloodrage: your attacks hit harder the lower your HP, up to +50% damage near death.

_comment: Dark Monarch: rules the field, drains the life it takes.
name: Dark Monarch
title: 🖤 The Dark Monarch
flavor: A crown for the one who reigns over the battlefield. What you take from the enemy, you keep for yourself.
signatureDesc: Dread Sovereign: take 20% less damage from every hit, and heal for 15% of the damage you deal.

_comment: Totem Pack: bundles the existing death-save relics; adds NO new gear. Signature enhances the death-save moment.
name: Totem Pack
title: 🗿 The Undying
flavor: Three old relics bound as one. When the killing blow comes, something older than you refuses it.
signatureDesc: Undying Flourish: when a death-save relic saves you from a fatal blow, you are cleansed of all effects and your MP is restored in full.

_comment: Knights of the Sicilian: disciplined counter-fencing. Comes with a rapier.
name: Knights of the Sicilian
title: ⚔️ Knight of the Sicilian
flavor: The order that never throws the first strike and never misses the second. Raise a hand to them and the rapier answers.
signatureDesc: Riposte: whenever an enemy hits you, they take 50% of that damage straight back.

_comment: Gemstone: comes with the Runic Shadow Sword; hits back with blue flame.
name: Gemstone
title: 💠 The Gemstone
flavor: Armor cut from a single living jewel, and the shadow blade that sleeps inside it. Strike the gem and it strikes back in cold blue fire.
signatureDesc: Blue Flame: anyone who hits you is set alight with cold fire, burning for 2 turns.

_comment: Arlnord's Divine Armor: the angel set. No weapon. Dodges nearly everything, capped at 70%.
name: Arlnord's Divine Armor
title: 😇 Arlnord the Divine
flavor: The armor of an angel that answered no summons and bowed to no king. Blades find only the space where grace used to be.
signatureDesc: Divine Dodge: 70% chance to avoid any incoming hit completely.
